info.title: Sync2Books Compliance API (eTIMS)
info.description:
Register items, issue sales and credit notes, record stock and read supplier invoices for a Kenyan business, with every fiscal document signed by KRA eTIMS.

Authenticate with an API key from the compliance dashboard, sent in the `x-api-key` header or as a bearer token. A `cmp_sk_test_...` key acts on sandbox businesses and a `cmp_sk_live_...` key on production ones; both use the same base URL.

New here? Start with the [eTIMS quickstart](/etims-quickstart). The conventions every endpoint shares are in [Authentication & API keys](/etims-authentication), [Errors & Troubleshooting](/etims-errors), [Idempotency](/etims-idempotency) and [Rate limits](/etims-rate-limits).

This is a separate product from the [Accounting API](/api-reference), with its own keys.

servers.description: Sync2Books Compliance API. The key you use decides whether a call reaches the KRA sandbox or production.

get.description:
Returns the application, environment and permissions behind the key you used. This is the first call to make: it confirms the key works and tells you what it may do.

Needs no scope: any valid key can call it.

businessId.description: The business a business-bound key is limited to. `null` for an organisation-wide key.

rateLimitPerMin.description: Requests per minute your application may make.

get.description:
Lists the businesses this key can act for, in the key's own environment. A business-bound key sees only its business. Use this to find the `businessId` an organisation-wide key must send.

Required scope: `lookups:read`.

Returns one business with its branches.

Required scope: `lookups:read`.

Lists the branches of a business. Branches are created in the compliance dashboard; this endpoint only reads them.

Required scope: `lookups:read`.

post.description:
Creates an item, or updates the one with the same `externalId`. The item starts as `PENDING`: it is **not** registered with KRA until you call `POST /v1/items/{id}/register`. The call returns `201` for both a create and an update.

Required scope: `catalog:write`.

get.description:
Lists every item of the business that has not been deleted. The list is not paginated.

Required scope: `catalog:read`.

Returns one item. An unknown id, an id of another business and a deleted item all answer `404`.

Required scope: `catalog:read`.

post.description:
Registers the item with KRA so it can be sold. The body is optional. If KRA rejects the item, or it is missing something, the response is a `422` that includes the item so you can see `needs` and `registrationStatus`.

Required scope: `catalog:write`.

422.description: KRA did not register the item, or the item is not ready to be registered.

error.message: This item cannot be registered yet. See item.needs for what is missing, add it with POST /v1/items, then register again.
The KRA reason for the rejection.

post.description:
Adds or deducts stock for an item at a branch and reports the movement to KRA. Each call is a separate movement; it is not de-duplicated. The call returns `201`.

Required scope: `stock:write`.

Moves stock of one item between two branches of the business. The call returns `201`.

Required scope: `stock:write`.

Validates the sale, submits it to KRA and returns the signed receipt. Prices are **tax inclusive**: the VAT split is worked out per line from the item's tax type, never from the request.

The status code tells you where the sale stands: `201` accepted by KRA, `202` still in flight (poll `GET /v1/sales/{id}`), `422` rejected or failed. Repeating the request with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns `200` with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and files nothing new.

Required scope: `sales:write`.

200.description: A repeat of an earlier request. The original sale is returned and nothing is filed again.

202.description: The sale has not reached a result yet. Poll `GET /v1/sales/{id}` or wait for the callback.

409.description: The request conflicts with an existing document.

error.message: A sale with traderInvoiceNumber INV-2026-0001 already exists. Use a new number, or repeat the original request with its original Idempotency-Key.
Insufficient stock for the item.

422.description: The document was not accepted by KRA, or could not be submitted.

error.message: The document failed validation.
The item is not registered with KRA yet. Register the item with KRA (POST /v1/items/{id}/register), then POST /v1/sales/{id}/retry.
The KRA reason for the rejection.

get.description:
Lists sales and credit notes, newest first, a page at a time. Credit notes have `type: "credit_note"`.

Required scope: `sales:read`.

Returns one sale or credit note, including the state of its result callback.

Required scope: `sales:read`.

Returns the KRA receipt as a PDF. It is only available once KRA has accepted the document; before that the call is a `404`. Pass `copy=true` for a customer copy marked COPY. The response is a file, so the playground cannot show it: use `curl -o receipt.pdf`.

Required scope: `sales:read`.

parameters.name: copy
parameters.description: Send `true` to get a copy marked COPY. Any other value gives the original.

post.description:
Submits a sale or credit note again when it did not reach KRA, or KRA rejected it, for example after you registered a missing item. There is no request body. If it fails again the response is a `422` `kra_rejected`.

Required scope: `sales:write`.

error.message: The KRA reason for the rejection.

post.description:
Delivers the latest result of this sale to its `callbackUrl` once, now. Use it when your endpoint was down for longer than the automatic retries last. The response says how the attempt went. It is a `404` if the sale was created without a `callbackUrl` and a `409` if the sale has no result yet.

Required scope: `sales:write`.

200.description: The delivery state after the attempt.

409.description: The sale has no result from KRA yet.

error.message: This sale has no result from KRA yet; its callback is sent when it does.

post.description:
Reverses an accepted sale **in full**. The buyer and lines are copied from the sale, so you send only the sale id, your own number and a return date. A sale can be credited once. The status codes work as for `POST /v1/sales`: `201` accepted, `202` in flight, `422` rejected, and `200` with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` for a repeated request.

Required scope: `sales:write`.

201.description: KRA accepted the credit note. The response key is `sale`, with `type: "credit_note"`.

200.description: A repeat of an earlier request. The original credit note is returned and nothing is filed again.

202.description: The credit note has not reached a result yet.

409.description: The request conflicts with an existing document.

error.message: This sale has already been credited by credit note CN-2026-0001. A credit note reverses a sale in full, so it can only be issued once.
Credit note CN-2026-0001 for this sale has not reached a result from KRA yet. Wait for it, or re-drive it with POST /v1/sales/{id}/retry, instead of issuing another.

422.description: The document was not accepted by KRA, or could not be submitted.

error.message: A credit note can only reverse a sale, not another credit note.
Only a sale KRA has accepted can be credited. Retry or fix the sale first.
The KRA reason for the rejection.

post.description:
Fetches the supplier invoices KRA holds for the business and stores them, branch by branch. The response says how each branch went. Pulling again never changes an invoice's review status. If KRA returns nothing for every branch (all of them fail) the call is a `502` that carries the same per-branch report. The body is optional.

Required scope: `purchases:read`.

200.description: KRA answered for at least one branch.

502.description: KRA did not return purchases for any branch.

error.message: KRA did not return purchases for any branch. Try again shortly.

get.description:
Lists the supplier invoices stored for the business, newest first, a page at a time. Call `POST /v1/purchases/pull` first to fetch the latest from KRA. This API only reads them: confirming or rejecting an invoice is done in the compliance dashboard.

Required scope: `purchases:read`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only invoices in this review status.

get.description:
Returns one stored supplier invoice.

Required scope: `purchases:read`.

Searches KRA's item classification codes. Send the `code` you choose as `classificationCode` when you create an item. These are KRA's own tables, the same for every business, so no business is involved.

Required scope: `lookups:read`.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Text to search for in the code or name.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Only classifications at this level of KRA's hierarchy.

get.description:
Returns one classification by its code. An unknown code is a `404`.

Required scope: `lookups:read`.

Lists KRA's code groups, for example `10` unit of quantity, `17` packaging unit and `04` tax type. Pass a group to `GET /v1/lookups/codes` to see its values.

Required scope: `lookups:read`.

Searches the codes within a group: quantity units, packaging units, tax types, payment types and more. Use `GET /v1/lookups/code-classes` to see the groups.

Required scope: `lookups:read`.

parameters.name: codeClass
parameters.description: The code group, for example `10` for quantity units or `17` for packaging units.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Text to search for in the code or name.

post.description: When you send a `callbackUrl` with a sale or credit note, Sync2Books sends the result there as a `POST` once KRA accepts or rejects it. Reply with any `2xx` within 10 seconds. The call is **not signed**: treat it as a notification and confirm with `GET /v1/sales/{id}` before you act on it. See [Result callbacks](/etims-callbacks).

200.description: Any `2xx` response marks the delivery as received.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your API key, for example `cmp_sk_test_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`. Create one on the Integrations page of the compliance dashboard.

BearerAuth.description: The same key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Use this if your HTTP client makes custom headers awkward.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed per minute for your application.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current one-minute window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current window resets. This is a number of seconds, not a Unix timestamp.

IdempotentReplayed.description: Always `true`. Present only when the response is an earlier result returned for a repeated `Idempotency-Key`.

BusinessId.name: businessId
BusinessId.description: The business to act for. Required for organisation-wide keys; omit it for a business-bound key. List the ids you can use with `GET /v1/businesses`.

BusinessPath.name: businessId
BusinessPath.description: The business id. A business-bound key must pass its own business id.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A unique value you choose for this document, 8 to 128 characters: letters, digits and `. _ : -`. Repeating the request with the same key returns the original result instead of filing a second document. Strongly recommended.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `pagination.nextCursor` value from the previous page, passed back unchanged.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Items per page, 1 to 100. A value outside that range is a 400, not clamped.

StartDate.name: startDate
StartDate.description: Only documents on or after this date, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

EndDate.name: endDate
EndDate.description: Only documents on or before this date, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

SaleId.name: id
SaleId.description: The id of a sale or credit note, as returned in `data.sale.id`.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed. The message names the first field that is wrong.

error.message: lines[0].quantity must be greater than 0

Unauthorized.description: The key is missing, malformed, revoked, expired or belongs to a suspended application. The response never says which.

error.message: Invalid API key

Forbidden.description: The key is valid but may not do this: a missing scope, a business the key is not limited to, or a test key used against a production business (or the reverse).

error.message: This API key is missing the sales:write scope
This API key is limited to a single business and cannot act for another one.
This is a test API key and Example Business Ltd is a production business. Use the key for that environment.

NotFound.description: The id does not exist, or belongs to another business. The two cases are deliberately indistinguishable.

error.message: Sale sale_example_9 not found

RateLimited.description: The application has used its requests for this minute. Wait `Retry-After` seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before trying again.

error.message: Rate limit of 120 requests per minute exceeded. Retry in 23s.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable code. Branch on this. See [Errors & Troubleshooting](/etims-errors) for the full list.

message.description: A human-readable explanation. The wording can change; do not parse it.

error.description: Some errors carry extra fields next to `code` and `message`, for example `sale`, `item`, `errors`, `creditNoteId` or `branches`.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

kraBhfId.description: The branch id KRA knows the branch by.

Environment.description: `SANDBOX` is the KRA test environment. `PRODUCTION` files real tax documents.

TaxCategory.description: `VAT_STANDARD` is KRA tax type B (16%), `VAT_ZERO` is C (0%), `EXEMPT` is A, `OTHER` is D and `VAT_8` is E (8%).

id.description: The item id. Use it on sale lines and stock movements.

externalId.description: Your own identifier for the item.

taxTypeCode.description: The KRA tax type letter the category maps to.

stockTracked.description: Whether sales of this item deduct stock.

registrationStatus.description: Only a `REGISTERED` item can be sold.

needs.description: Why an item is not yet ready to register.

externalId.description: Your own identifier. Sending it again updates the same item.

productTypeCode.description: A string, not a number. `1` raw material, `2` finished product, `3` service.

classificationCode.description: The KRA item classification. Required before the item can be registered. Search with `GET /v1/lookups/classifications`.

unitCode.description: KRA quantity unit code, for example `U`. See `GET /v1/lookups/codes?codeClass=10`.

packagingUnitCode.description: KRA packaging unit code, for example `NT`. See `GET /v1/lookups/codes?codeClass=17`.

businessId.description: The business to act for. Required for organisation-wide keys; omit it for a business-bound key. List the ids you can use with `GET /v1/businesses`.

branchId.description: The branch to register the item for. Accepts the branch `id` or its `kraBhfId`. Defaults to the business's first branch.

force.description: Set `true` to register again an item KRA already has.

businessId.description: The business to act for. Required for organisation-wide keys; omit it for a business-bound key. List the ids you can use with `GET /v1/businesses`.

reason.description: Why the step was skipped or failed.

branchId.description: Defaults to the business's first branch.

referenceId.description: Your own reference for the movement.

businessId.description: The business to act for. Required for organisation-wide keys; omit it for a business-bound key. List the ids you can use with `GET /v1/businesses`.
The business to act for. Required for organisation-wide keys; omit it for a business-bound key. List the ids you can use with `GET /v1/businesses`.

unitPrice.description: The price the customer pays per unit, tax included.

CallbackUrl.description: Where to send the result. An absolute `https` URL on a public host, with no credentials in it. See [Result callbacks](/etims-callbacks).

traderInvoiceNumber.description: Your own number for this sale. Unique per business.

paymentTypeCode.description: A KRA payment type code. See [Codes & Values](/etims-codes#payment-type-sales).

branchId.description: Defaults to the business's first branch.

businessId.description: The business to act for. Required for organisation-wide keys; omit it for a business-bound key. List the ids you can use with `GET /v1/businesses`.

traderInvoiceNumber.description: Your own number for the credit note.

saleId.description: The id of the accepted sale to reverse.

reason.description: `01` missing quantity, `02` missing data, `03` damaged, `04` wasted, `05` raw material shortage, `06` refund.

businessId.description: The business to act for. Required for organisation-wide keys; omit it for a business-bound key. List the ids you can use with `GET /v1/businesses`.

Callback.description: Delivery state of the result callback. `null` when the sale was created without a `callbackUrl`.

taxableAmount.description: The part of the total that is subject to tax.

taxTypeCode.description: The KRA tax type letter of the item.

Receipt.description: The KRA-signed receipt values. `null` until KRA has accepted the document.

cuInvoiceNo.description: The control unit invoice number printed on the receipt.

receiptLabel.description: For example `NS` for a sale and `NC` for a credit note.

verificationUrl.description: The KRA page that verifies the receipt. The QR code on the PDF points here.

originalCuInvoiceNo.description: On a credit note, the CU invoice number of the sale it reverses.

Sale.description: A sale or a credit note. On a credit note the amounts are negative.

status.description: `completed` means KRA accepted the document. `pending`, `ready_to_submit` and `retrying` are still in flight.

originalSaleId.description: On a credit note, the id of the sale it reverses.

error.description: Why the document failed. Set only when `status` is `failed`.

CallbackPayload.description: The body sent to your `callbackUrl`. It is not signed: confirm with `GET /v1/sales/{id}` before acting on it.

id.description: Stable across retries of the same result. Use it to ignore duplicates.

branchId.description: Pull for one branch only. Defaults to every branch of the business.

businessId.description: The business to act for. Required for organisation-wide keys; omit it for a business-bound key. List the ids you can use with `GET /v1/businesses`.

fetched.description: Invoices KRA returned for this branch. `0` when the branch failed.

Purchase.description: A supplier invoice KRA holds against the business.

branch.description: The name of the branch the invoice belongs to.

confirmationError.description: Why the last attempt to confirm the invoice to KRA failed, if it did.

level.description: Position in KRA's hierarchy. 1 is the broadest.
